access_boundary: This record represents the deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3.2 repository release at commit a7e62ac04ecb2c0a54d736dc46601c5606cf10a6 (last modified 2025-12-01). DeepSeek-V3.2-Speciale, DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp and its base model, the DeepSeek API's deepseek-chat and deepseek-reasoner names, and downstream quantizations remain separate boundaries.
strengths: Developer-published Safetensors shards, tokenizer, encoding utilities, and a repository MIT license file that the model card applies to the weights
The model card distinguishes this release from the Speciale and Exp variants, documents the thinking-with-tools message format, and links a technical report
tradeoffs: Self-hosting guidance is delegated to the DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp repository rather than documented in this release's own card
DeepSeek's API change log retired the model names that served this release, so first-party managed access has ended and the card itself carries no dates
